title: What one stat point is worth in battle

vitality_hp.description: Max HP per point of Vitality.

might_damage.description: Damage per point of Might added to each skull match, skull bomb and weapon swing.

mastery_points_per_mana.description: Mastery points per bonus mana on each match of that color (rounded down).

mastery_extra_turn_percent.description: Chance per mastery point that a match of that color grants an extra turn.

cunning_resist_percent.description: Chance per point of Cunning to resist an enemy's resistible status.
